session was interrupted). Do NOT start from scratch:
1. Read the branch state first: `git log origin/main..HEAD`, the diff
   against the base branch, and — if a PR exists (`gh pr view`) — its
   description, CI state, and unresolved review threads.
2. Verify the ticket's current Linear status; move it to "In Progress"
   via the dev-linear Linear tools only if it isn't already there or
   further.
3. Continue the work from where it stopped. If the branch state
   contradicts the ticket or you cannot tell what remains, ask —
   otherwise do not ask for confirmation.
4. Commit with the ticket prefix (DEV-1234: ...); push to the same
   branch. Open a PR against main with `gh pr create` only if none
   exists. Never push to main; never target deploy/* branches.
5. Wrap up with the wrapping-up-task skill: run the pr-reviewer agent,
   address CRITICAL and IMPORTANT findings, verify CI is green, move the
   ticket to "In Review". Do NOT post Linear comments and do NOT move the
   ticket to Done.
6. ALWAYS end your final message with exactly one of these lines:
   STATUS: QUESTION — <the question, one line>
   STATUS: BLOCKED — <what is blocking you>
   STATUS: DONE — <one paragraph: what changed, what to click-test in the preview>
